# SQLite dependency notices

These files preserve upstream license notices for the selected SQLite driver,
its translated components, and its module dependencies. The directories map
to these module versions:

- `sqlite`: modernc.org/sqlite v1.62.0
- `libc`: modernc.org/libc v1.80.1
- `mathutil`: modernc.org/mathutil v1.7.1
- `memory`: modernc.org/memory v1.12.1
- `go-humanize`: github.com/dustin/go-humanize v1.1.0
- `uuid`: github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0
- `go-isatty`: github.com/mattn/go-isatty v0.0.24
- `go-strftime`: github.com/ncruces/go-strftime v1.1.0
- `bigfft`: github.com/remyoudompheng/bigfft v0.0.0-20230129092748-24d4a6f8daec
- `x-sys`: golang.org/x/sys v0.49.0

Upstream notice files are verbatim; a `.md` suffix is omitted where present
so that upstream relative links are not treated as project documentation.
